possibleStrengthsAndTradeoffs.text: 2,500 mm wheelbase with a 9.8 m kerb-to-kerb turning circle gives a concrete starting point for route and depot-access planning. Cab-chassis length is 4,716 mm.
41.3 kWh declared 1-pack LFP system supports up to 11 kW AC and 70 kW DC. Published charge times lack a state-of-charge window.

Active Brake Assist 5, Sideguard Assist and lane-departure warning are standard; electric power take-off is an option for compatible bodies. Finished-body suitability still needs a body-builder assessment.
